row.notes: (count, flags, mode1, mode2): 5 LED bits for one rev-light group: bit k lit when count>k (flags bit1) or only bit0 (flags bit2); mode1 ORs flags bits 4..8, mode2 ORs bits 10..14 into LEDs 0..4; returns b0|b1<<1|b2<<2|b3<<3|b4<<4. Caller Car_SteeringWheelLeds_Update (counts n, n-5, n-10). (lane owner review requested)
